columns.name: patch_id

columns.name: hero_name

columns.name: picks

columns.name: bans

tables.description: The hero roster, one row per hero, with primary attribute, attack type and roles.

columns.name: hero_id
columns.description: OpenDota hero id; primary key.

columns.name: hero_name
columns.description: Display name, e.g. Windranger.

columns.name: hero_key
columns.description: Internal key, e.g. npc_dota_hero_windrunner.

columns.name: primary_attribute
columns.description: Primary attribute: str, agi, int or all (universal).

columns.name: attack_type

tables.description: One row per item in OpenDota's item constants, with the flags the item marts share. is_major_item marks a finished item worth planning a build around - at least 2000 gold, assembled from components or carrying its own active ability, and not a recipe, consumable or neutral item.

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: OpenDota item id; primary key; the value in the player item slots.

columns.name: item_key
columns.description: Internal key, e.g. black_king_bar; the key in purchase logs.

columns.name: item_name
columns.description: Display name, e.g. Black King Bar; null for a few internal items.

columns.name: item_cost
columns.description: Shop price in gold; 0 for items with no price (neutral items, enchantments, wards, Roshan drops).

columns.name: quality
columns.description: OpenDota item quality: component, rare, epic, consumable, artifact, common, secret_shop; null for many items and not a reliable finished-or-component flag (the upgraded Blinks are marked component).

columns.name: neutral_tier
columns.description: Neutral item tier 1-5 from the constants; null for shop items, enchantments, and a few neutral items the constants leave untiered (Disgraced Regalia, Gris-Gris).

columns.name: component_count
columns.description: Number of components the item is assembled from in the constants (recipes not counted as components); 0 for items bought whole.

columns.name: has_active_ability
columns.description: True when the constants list an active ability for the item (Blink Dagger, Dagon, Black King Bar ...).

columns.name: is_recipe
columns.description: True for recipe scrolls (item key starting with recipe).

columns.name: is_consumable
columns.description: True for items of consumable quality (Tango, Clarity, Moon Shard, Cheese ...).

columns.name: is_neutral
columns.description: True for neutral items (a tier in the constants) and for enchantments (keys starting with enhancement).

columns.name: is_major_item
columns.description: True for a major item: item_cost at least 2000, assembled from components or with an active ability, and not a recipe, consumable or neutral item. The cheapest are Crystalys (2000) and Kaya, Sange and Yasha (2100); Demon Edge, Hyperstone, Mystic Staff, Ultimate Orb, Eaglesong, Reaver and Sacred Relic are components, not major items.

tables.description: Leagues and tournaments OpenDota rates premium or professional, one row per league. Leagues it rates below professional, or does not rate, are not listed.

columns.name: league_id
columns.description: OpenDota league id; primary key.

columns.name: league_name
columns.description: League or tournament name.

columns.name: league_tier
columns.description: OpenDota tier: premium or professional.

tables.description: Game versions as time windows, one row per patch; a patch runs from its release until the next one, and the current patch has no end.

columns.name: patch_id
columns.description: OpenDota patch id, sequential from 0 = 6.70; primary key.

columns.name: patch_name
columns.description: Version string, e.g. 7.41; letter sub-patches (7.40c) are not separate rows.

columns.name: patch_started_at
columns.description: Release time of the patch (timestamp with time zone).

columns.name: patch_ended_at
columns.description: Release time of the next patch; null for the current one.

columns.name: is_current
columns.description: True for exactly one row, the patch with no end.

tables.description: OpenDota's patch notes, one row per note line, with the hero or item the line is about resolved to its display name.

columns.name: patch_name
columns.description: Version the note belongs to, including letter sub-patches, e.g. 7.40c; matches dim_patch.patch_name only for main versions.

columns.name: section
columns.description: general, heroes or items.

columns.name: subject
columns.description: Internal key of the hero (without npc_dota_hero_) or item the line is about, or general.

columns.name: subject_name
columns.description: Display name of the hero or item, e.g. Pudge or Black King Bar; falls back to subject when no match.

columns.name: heading
columns.description: Heroes section only: the ability key (e.g. tiny_grow) or group (talents, general, hero_facet) the line sits under; null elsewhere.

columns.name: line_no
columns.description: Order of the line within its patch, section and subject, 0-based; gaps where blank lines were dropped.

columns.name: note
columns.description: The text of the patch-note line.

tables.description: Players OpenDota lists as professional, one row per account, with the competitive name, last team and country; rows without a name are dropped.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Steam account id (32-bit); primary key; joins fact_player_match.account_id.

columns.name: player_name
columns.description: Competitive name, e.g. Yatoro.

columns.name: persona_name
columns.description: Steam persona name; changes often, prefer player_name.

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: Last team OpenDota has for the player; 0 when none.

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: Name of that team.

columns.name: team_tag
columns.description: Tag of that team.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: Two-letter country code, lowercase; empty or null when unknown.

columns.name: last_match_at
columns.description: Start time of the player's most recent match OpenDota knows; null when unknown.

tables.description: Professional teams, one row per team; every team in OpenDota's ranking (the top thousand by rating, with rating and all-time records) and every team identified on a loaded pro match, so a team id on a match always resolves here. A team that is not ranked and played only in leagues OpenDota rates below professional has no row. Most teams that play in the window are outside the ranking and carry only a name and their loaded matches.

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: OpenDota team id; primary key.

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: Team name; from the ranking when the team is ranked, else from its latest loaded match.

columns.name: team_tag
columns.description: Short team tag; null for a team outside the ranking.

columns.name: rating
columns.description: OpenDota Elo-style team rating; null for a team outside the ranking.

columns.name: all_time_wins
columns.description: Wins over the team's whole OpenDota history, not the loaded window; null for a team outside the ranking.

columns.name: all_time_losses
columns.description: Losses over the team's whole OpenDota history, not the loaded window; null for a team outside the ranking.

columns.name: last_match_at
columns.description: Start time of the team's most recent match OpenDota knows; null for a team outside the ranking.

columns.name: is_ranked
columns.description: True when the team is in OpenDota's ranking, so rating and the all-time records are present.

columns.name: loaded_matches
columns.description: Pro matches of the team in the loaded window, premium and professional leagues only; 0 for a ranked team with none.

columns.name: last_loaded_match_at
columns.description: Start time of the team's latest loaded match; null when it has none.

tables.description: Every pick and ban of a Captains Mode professional match with its draft phase and its place among the picks, one row per pick or ban. The draft on these patches runs 7 bans, 2 picks, 3 bans, 6 picks, 4 bans, 2 picks; the phase is read from the runs of consecutive bans or picks, so a draft with a skipped ban (23 actions) keeps its phases. Matches in other game modes are not included.

columns.name: match_id
columns.description: OpenDota match id; with draft_order the primary key; joins fact_match.match_id.

columns.name: draft_order
columns.description: Position in the draft sequence, 0-based (0-23, or 0-22 when a ban was skipped).

columns.name: action
columns.description: 'pick' or 'ban'.

columns.name: is_pick
columns.description: True for a pick.

columns.name: is_ban
columns.description: True for a ban (the negation of is_pick).

columns.name: draft_phase
columns.description: Draft phase 1-3. Each phase is a run of bans followed by a run of picks: phase 1 is 7 bans then 2 picks, phase 2 is 3 bans then 6 picks, phase 3 is 4 bans then 2 picks (one fewer ban when a ban was skipped).

columns.name: phase_name
columns.description: The phase and action together: 'ban phase 1', 'pick phase 1', 'ban phase 2', 'pick phase 2', 'ban phase 3' or 'pick phase 3'.

columns.name: match_pick_number
columns.description: For a pick, its place among the match's ten picks (1 = the first pick of the match, 10 = the last); null for a ban.

columns.name: team_pick_number
columns.description: For a pick, its place among its own side's five picks (1-5); null for a ban.

columns.name: match_ban_number
columns.description: For a ban, its place among the match's bans (1-14, or 1-13 when a ban was skipped); null for a pick.

columns.name: is_first_pick
columns.description: True for the first pick of the match (the first hero either side locked in).

columns.name: is_last_pick
columns.description: True for the last pick of the match (the tenth hero, picked knowing the other nine).

columns.name: is_first_pick_side
columns.description: True when the side that made this pick or ban also made the match's first pick.

columns.name: hero_id
columns.description: Hero picked or banned; joins dim_hero.hero_id.

columns.name: hero_name
columns.description: Display name of the hero picked or banned.

columns.name: is_radiant
columns.description: True when the Radiant side made this pick or ban.

columns.name: side
columns.description: 'radiant' or 'dire', the side that made this pick or ban.

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: Team id of the side that made the pick or ban; null when not identified.

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: Team name of the side that made the pick or ban; null when not identified.

columns.name: opponent_team_name
columns.description: Team name of the other side; null when not identified.

columns.name: side_won
columns.description: True when the side that made this pick or ban won the match.

columns.name: started_at
columns.description: Match start time (timestamp with time zone).

columns.name: match_date
columns.description: UTC calendar date of started_at.

columns.name: patch_id
columns.description: Game version id the match was played on; joins dim_patch.patch_id.

columns.name: patch_name
columns.description: Game version the match was played on, e.g. 7.41.

columns.name: league_id
columns.description: League or tournament id; joins dim_league.league_id.

columns.name: league_name
columns.description: League or tournament name as the match record carries it.

tables.description: Per identified team, hero and patch, how often the team played the hero and won with it, beside how often all pro teams played it. Only heroes the team played at least once have a row.

columns.name: team_id
columns.description: The team; with patch_id and hero_id the primary key; joins dim_team.team_id.

columns.name: team_name
columns.description: The team's name.

columns.name: patch_id
columns.description: Game version id; joins dim_patch.patch_id.

columns.name: patch_name
columns.description: Game version, e.g. 7.41.

columns.name: hero_id
columns.description: The hero; joins dim_hero.hero_id.

columns.name: hero_name
columns.description: Display name of the hero.

columns.name: games
columns.description: The team's pro matches on this patch in which it played the hero.

columns.name: wins
columns.description: Of those matches, the ones the team won.

columns.name: team_matches
columns.description: All of the team's pro matches on this patch; the same on every row of the team and patch.

columns.name: team_pick_rate
columns.description: games / team_matches, the share of the team's matches on this patch in which it played the hero. A per-row value; do not sum or average it across rows.

columns.name: field_pick_rate
columns.description: Share of all pro matches on this patch in which either side played the hero, the baseline to compare team_pick_rate against. A per-row value.

columns.name: pick_rate_lift
columns.description: team_pick_rate minus field_pick_rate, in shares (0.25 = 25 percentage points). High means the team plays the hero far more than the field does, which is what makes it a signature hero. A per-row value.

tables.description: One row per player per parsed pro match: observer and sentry wards placed (from the ward logs), runes taken by type (picked up or bottled, from the rune log), and buybacks with the first one's minute.
